_note: Paid ad tests watched by agents/ad-test-monitor. Campaign stop rules only REPORT. The one write: a test with kill.autoPause pauses its losing creatives daily (Sean, 2026-10-07). tests._note: All approved creatives (Trybe UGC + our Sensitive Skin Set images) in one CBO campaign, plus DPA retargeting at $10/day. Readout every 3 days (Sean, 2026-10-04). Budget raised 2026-10-07 by Sean to $100/day total ($90 test + $10 DPA) with 36 ads live, on the view that Meta picks the winners; graduates still move to a scaling campaign by post ID. Test campaign cut back to $50/day on 2026-10-08 by Sean ($60/day total with DPA).

graduation._note: Sean 2026-10-07: graduate after minSpend on EITHER cost per purchase <= one average order, OR minAddToCarts at minLinkCtr. Replaced a $1.50 cost-per-click bar no ad could clear at a ~$75 CPM.

kill._note: Sean 2026-10-07: pause losers daily to stop the bleeding instead of waiting for the weekly drop. A loser spent about one average order with no add to cart or purchase. Never thins the campaign below minActive running ads.

tests.cadence: New creatives go in once a week on MONDAY in one batch, never daily (every new ad pulls delivery while it learns). Graduates move to a scaling campaign by post ID.
